title: Helmholtz Free Energy
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct thermodynamic definition of the Helmholtz free energy F and define all symbols used.

title: Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct classical statistical mechanical definition of the partition function Z and define all symbols used.

title: Relationship Between F and Z
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly state the relationship between F and Z as F = -kT ln Z.

title: Heat Capacity Derivation
description: Important Criteria: Correctly derive the expression for heat capacity at constant volume c_v using thermodynamic arguments.

title: Correct Expression for Z
description: Important Criteria: Correctly calculate the partition function Z for the two discrete energy states.

title: Final Expression for c_v
description: Important Criteria: Correctly derive the final expression for c_v in terms of the energy states.

title: Symbol Definitions
description: Optional Criteria: Define all symbols used in the expressions clearly and accurately.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of c_v and related expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
